power.method: PoE (802.3at, Type 2, Class 4), max. 12.7W, or 12 VDC max. 11.2W

features: DeepinViewX 8MP turret with dedicated Guanlan large-scale AI model for perimeter protection (~90% fewer false alarms)
AI Encoding — cuts storage ~50% while preserving human/vehicle image quality
multi-target-type detection — simultaneous human body, face and vehicle capture with feature extraction
face capture — up to 60 faces simultaneously (swing -60 to 60, tilt -30 to 30)
regional people counting — density / people-exception / waiting-time exception detection, up to 8 regions
heat map (space + time), on/off duty detection, AcuSeek search (with AcuSeek NVR/servers)
perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exiting with combined event alarms
AI Open Platform — 4 loadable model packages, up to 16 target types each
130 dB WDR, DarkFighter 2.0 low-light, blue-glass day/night module

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 8MP DeepinViewX fixed-lens turret for perimeter protection with face capture, regional people counting, heat map and AI Encoding (Guanlan model). 8MP sibling of the iDS-2CD5347G2/V-XS.
